t: You're on Morpeth Terrace, a street in Victoria, in the City of Westminster. Two notable people are tied to it. Barnett Janner died here in 1982. He was a British politician, first elected as a Liberal MP and later sitting as a Labour MP, and he ended up in the House of Lords as Baron Janner. The Scottish rugby player Peter Kininmonth also lived here. He played for Scotland and the Lions, as well as for Oxford University and Richmond.
